description: IRVE (Infrastructures de Recharge pour ) dans le Grand Avignon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Avignon. GRAND AVIGNON has the ‘transport and travel’ competence, entrusting it with the task of improving accessibility to the 16 municipalities and facilitating the movement of the inhabitants of the agglomeration, while ensuring that economic interests, the environment and the quality of life are safeguarded. Coverage: Grand Avignon. The portal shows the English title as "IRVE (Recharge Infrastructures for Electric Vehicles) in Greater Avignon" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Avignon. Its keywords include mobilite-douce, voiture, electrique. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHP, GEOJSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
